subject.title: Unhandled socket error in SSRF fetch wrapper can kill the gateway process (IPv6-only DNS + Happy Eyeballs)

question: Should maintainers accept the linked PR's socket-error handling direction for the SSRF security boundary, or require a different Undici-compatible connector shape first?
rationale: The issue affects gateway availability in SSRF-guarded network code, and the current candidate fix touches dependency contracts and DNS-pinning behavior that automation should not bless without maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair and prove linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while the linked PR preserves explicit-proxy pinning, fixes the Undici connector contract issue, and adds IPv6-unreachable proof.

options.title: Request different fix shape
options.body: Ask for a lower-level or alternative Undici-compatible socket handling approach before accepting any security-boundary patch.

recommendation.title: Repair and prove linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while the linked PR preserves explicit-proxy pinning, fixes the Undici connector contract issue, and adds IPv6-unreachable proof.
